bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
file="$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
cmp -s "$file" <(git -C "$root" show d2590341c0745396b17e6a83764f84922cd90e01:deploy/gserver-compose.yaml) || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:jitsi-450a4d6)" || exit 62
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 63
docker inspect --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 | grep -q '^GAYBBS_NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_ENABLED=enabled$' || exit 64
echo NOTIFICATION_WORKER_CONFIG_VERIFIED
echo JITSI_LIVE_IMAGE_UNCHANGED
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "SELECT 'notification:'||state||':'||count(*) FROM announcement_notifications GROUP BY state ORDER BY state; SELECT 'application:'||status||':'||count(*) FROM announcement_applications GROUP BY status ORDER BY status;"
echo TRACKED_DIRTY_SCOPE_BEGIN
git -C "$root" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no
